target_user: One person keeping track of their own books at home
core_utility: A simple personal home library tracker. Add each book with title, author, and type; note who has borrowed one and clear it when it comes back; see all books in one list and filter to just those currently lent out.
assumptions: Borrower is a free-text name, not a separate contacts list
Lent-on date is optional extra detail; presence of a borrower name is what marks a book lent out
Lent out status auto-derives from the borrower field so it can never drift from the truth
